create.name: Saqib Rizvi
create.bio:
Saqib Rizvi is a meditation teacher and spiritual mentor based in Vancouver who brings the mystical strands of several traditions, among them Buddhism, Sufism, Taoism, Hindu thought and Christian mysticism, into conversation with a scientific outlook. He trained first as an engineer in electronics and telecommunications and later took an MBA before turning to meditation. He studied at the Tushita meditation centre in Dharamsala, worked at Zorba the Buddha in Delhi, and has led programmes in India and Canada.

His teaching centres on awareness and the ego: what the ego is, how it can soften, and how to live with a healthy one. On Insight Timer he publishes guided meditations, talks and multi-day courses on subjects such as non-duality, Rumi's poetry, intuition, Jung's active imagination and manifesting without grasping, and he holds regular live sessions there. He also runs longer live workshops over Zoom, most recently a twelve-week series on Buddhist mysticism and Tantra, and offers one-to-one mentoring aimed at awakening and personal growth. His YouTube channel and Substack carry talks and essays on mysticism, shadow work and the inner life.

courses.title: 1:1 Mentoring Sessions
courses.description: Private meditation-based mentoring with Saqib for people working on awakening and personal growth. He describes his approach as free of labels and grounded in full attention to the person in front of him; sessions are booked through his site.

courses.title: Non-Duality | Transcending The Ego
courses.description: An Insight Timer course introducing non-duality and the idea of seeing past the separate self, with teachings and guided practice in short daily sessions.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

courses.title: Love Nirvana: Rumi's Path To Awakening
courses.description: An Insight Timer course that follows Rumi's poetry and Sufi teaching on love as a way to awakening, pairing reflections with meditations.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

free_resources.title: Saqib Rizvi on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Free guided meditations and talks from Saqib drawing on Sufi, Buddhist, Taoist and Jungian ideas, plus regular free live sessions. Free to listen to on Insight Timer.
